scope: Minimal local Linux dependency/toolchain restoration and integrity verification only; not build/test qualification
execution_kind: Actual local execution, not static-only review

initial_install.scope: Downloaded and installed official Zig archive and fixed-pin minimal dependencies; verified archive, binary, version, dependency pins, retained licenses and exact Unicode sparse scope. This was the preceding script revision before whole-toolchain installed-file comparison was added.

existing_environment_rerun.output_hash_basis: SHA-256 of locally captured stdout/stderr files; raw logs are not published
existing_environment_rerun.scope: Reused existing archive, toolchain and dependency checkouts; compared every installed archive member and executed zig version only. No explicit download or Git fetch branch was needed.

zig.comparison: All archive regular-file bytes, sizes and executable bits; archive directory types and symbolic-link targets

limitations: The final published script revision was executed against the already restored environment. Its fresh-install path and interrupted-transfer/dirty-target failure cases were not separately exercised.

Repository source-tree qualification is recorded separately in restoration-validation.json. This environment verification checks root gitlink pins but does not claim that ongoing development work remains identical to the recovered source tree.
Successful restoration and integrity checks do not imply any passing project build, test, replay, benchmark or acceptance result.
Local state alone is not durable storage and does not establish executor stability.
